usedFor: Quora Lead Gen Forms captures leads, and Google Drive copies a file for each “New Lead” through “Copy a File”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Lead” in Quora Lead Gen Forms, then “Copy a File” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: Each lead gets its own copy of a template file, filed into the folder you choose.

watchOut: “New Lead” is polling, so “Copy a File” runs after a scheduled check, not at once.
